# barndoor_dlp_mcp_baseline_policy (Resource)

Manages the organization's Data Protection (DLP) Baseline MCP policy: the rules for every MCP server that no `barndoor_dlp_mcp_policy` covers.

The Baseline policy is a singleton; declare at most one of these per organization. Creating the resource takes over the existing Baseline policy and replaces its rules with the configured ones. The Baseline policy can't be deleted, so `terraform destroy` clears its rules instead: servers without their own policy are then unprotected.

The organization must be on MCP server policies. While it still manages MCP traffic through `barndoor_dlp_enforcement_policy`, this API is read-only and writes fail with a 409.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Rules for every MCP server that no barndoor_dlp_mcp_policy covers. The
# Baseline policy is a singleton: declare it once per organization.
# Destroying it clears its rules (the policy itself can't be deleted).
resource "barndoor_dlp_mcp_baseline_policy" "this" {
  rules = [
    {
      runtime_boundary     = "BOTH"
      action               = "POLICY_ACTION_REDACT"
      detection_engine_ids = ["00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"]
    },
    {
      # Observe-only: record findings in tool output without acting.
      runtime_boundary     = "TOOL_OUTPUT"
      action               = "POLICY_ACTION_BLOCK"
      dry_run              = true
      detection_engine_ids = ["00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"]
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rules` (Attributes List) Rules applied to every MCP server without its own policy, in order. Use `[]` for no rules. At most 50. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the Baseline policy was first saved (RFC 3339).
- `created_by` (String) Subject that first saved the Baseline policy (empty when the platform could not attribute it).
- `id` (String) UUID of the Baseline policy, assigned by the API on its first save.
- `updated_at` (String) When the Baseline policy was last updated (RFC 3339).
- `updated_by` (String) Subject that last updated the Baseline policy.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `action` (String) Action taken when a detection engine reports a finding: `POLICY_ACTION_TOKENIZE`, `POLICY_ACTION_REDACT`, `POLICY_ACTION_PASSTHROUGH`, `POLICY_ACTION_ALERT_ONLY`, `POLICY_ACTION_BLOCK`, `POLICY_ACTION_MASK`, or `POLICY_ACTION_OMIT`. Every referenced detection engine must support the action.
- `detection_engine_ids` (List of String) IDs (lowercase UUIDs) of the detection engines that trigger the rule. At least one is required, and each must belong to the organization.
- `runtime_boundary` (String) Which tool traffic the rule inspects: `TOOL_INPUT` (arguments sent to the tool), `TOOL_OUTPUT` (what the tool returns), or `BOTH`.

Optional:

- `agent_scope` (Attributes) AI agents the rule applies to. Omit to apply to every agent, including agents created later. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--agent_scope))
- `dry_run` (Boolean) Whether the rule only observes (records findings without acting). Defaults to `false`.
- `label` (String) Optional display label for the rule, up to 120 characters.
- `mask_format` (Attributes) Partial-redaction shape: keep a prefix or suffix of the matched value readable and mask the rest. Only valid with `action = "POLICY_ACTION_MASK"`; omit it to mask the whole value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--mask_format))
- `principal_scope` (Attributes) Users the rule applies to, by IdP group or role. Omit to apply to every user. A user matches the list when any of their groups or roles is in it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--principal_scope))

<a id="nestedatt--rules--agent_scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.agent_scope`

Required:

- `mode` (String) `ALL` (every agent), `ONLY` (just the agents in `agent_ids`), or `EXCEPT` (every agent but those in `agent_ids`).

Optional:

- `agent_ids` (Set of String) IDs (lowercase UUIDs) of registry agents: 1 to 200, required for `ONLY` and `EXCEPT` and not allowed for `ALL`.


<a id="nestedatt--rules--mask_format"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.mask_format`

Required:

- `keep` (String) Which end of the value stays readable: `PREFIX` or `SUFFIX`.
- `keep_chars` (Number) How many characters stay readable, 0 to 16.

Optional:

- `mask_char` (String) Character that replaces masked characters. Defaults to `X`.
- `preserve_separators` (Boolean) Whether separators such as `-` stay in place. Defaults to `true`.


<a id="nestedatt--rules--principal_scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.principal_scope`

Required:

- `mode` (String) `ALL` (every user), `ONLY` (just the listed groups and roles), or `EXCEPT` (every user but the listed groups and roles).

Optional:

- `principals` (Attributes Set) Groups and roles: 1 to 200, required for `ONLY` and `EXCEPT` and not allowed for `ALL`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--principal_scope--principals))

<a id="nestedatt--rules--principal_scope--principals"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.principal_scope.principals`

Required:

- `principal_id` (String) IdP group or role name.
- `principal_type` (String) Kind of principal: `GROUP` or `ROLE`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The organization comes from the provider credential, so the import ID is
# not looked up; by convention use "baseline". Read replaces it with the
# Baseline policy's UUID. A Baseline policy that was never saved can't be
# imported; apply the resource instead.
terraform import barndoor_dlp_mcp_baseline_policy.this baseline
```
